biggest_catch: Friend must complete a direct deposit, 12 debit card transactions, and eStatements within 60 days of account opening.
catches: Referrer earns a $100 reward bonus per qualifying referral; you will each receive the referral reward.
A Referrer may receive up to five (5) reward bonuses ($500 value) within a calendar year.

Referred person must register via the referral link, open a new First Heritage APEX Rewards Checking Account, and within 60 days: complete at least one direct deposit, complete twelve (12) debit card transactions (excluding ATM), and enroll in eStatements.
Referrer must register for the program and share the offer; only one referrer per referred person.
Allow 30 days for delivery of the reward bonus after all requirements are met; bonuses may be reported to the IRS.
Offer can be changed or revoked at any time without notice.

steps: Register your information on the official Refer-a-Friend page to create your referral profile.
Refer friends via contact info + email or social media.
Friend registers via your link, opens a new APEX Rewards Checking, and completes 1 direct deposit + 12 debit transactions + eStatements within 60 days.
You earn $100 per referral (up to $500/calendar year); reward delivered within 30 days.
timing: Reward delivered within 30 days after all requirements are met.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Reward delivered within 30 days after all requirements are met. — the program's payout window runs up to 30 days after qualification.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 30-day payout window is the binding constraint after qualification — nothing in the terms shortens it; compress the qualification leg instead.
